name: model-retry-backoff-then-fallback
description: After a crash re-send, the provider answers 429 with retry-after 2 s (waited as recorded), then 529 twice (backoff base x 2^(k-1) = 2 s). With fallback_after 2 a settings_changed{fallback} switches to the configured model, which answers. Every attempt and wait is an event; the SDK's own retries are off.
